name: Abelina
description:
About This Game

Death was the easy part.

Vasily died a while ago, and since then he’s been trying to find happiness in the afterlife with a small settlement of others: people who tend gardens, carve masks, and struggle to understand what this place really is. When a tragedy shakes up the relative peace, Vasily starts to realize that Abelina may be the real end for him. Unless… the universe has a backdoor.

Every element of Abelina was made by hand. Lantern-plants hang overhead in the dark, coral pools glow from underneath, and whole groves are lit up by their own flora. It is a long way from one side of this world to the other and the route is not always clear. Paths branch, dead-end, and open into vistas at every turn.

Each area in Abelina has its own ecology. An elusive fox leads into the shadows, pale apes called Komin build primitive structures, and airplane-sized moths glide overhead with stars swirling on their wings. There’s a giant beetle to ride up a hill, and phosphorescent goats to chase between the trees.

There is no combat in Abelina, so progress is all about exploration: climbing, jumping, finding secret paths and blowing open walls. The terrain gets more demanding the farther it gets from camp. When the way forward is sealed, there is always another way, and the world is built to reward the people who go looking for it.

  • A vast, hand-crafted world of surreal biomes and branching paths, built from scratch by one person.

  • A mature story about life and death, told through who you meet, with a dark sense of humor.

  • No combat. Platforming and exploration are the whole game.

  • Strange company: creatures that were never human, and companions who catch up to your campfire each night.

  • Production pedigree: a solo CG-cinematic veteran (Valorant, League of Legends, Netflix's Love, Death + Robots), and scored by Ryan Holladay, co-composer of Weapons and composer of Resident Evil (2026).
short_desc: A surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer. Vasily died and woke up in Abelina, a settlement in the afterlife. Now he’s heading into the frontier with his companions following behind. No combat, just a vast world to explore and a mature story about carrying life’s baggage into the afterlife.
